svg.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Vault Planner: tasks from Obsidian, Microsoft Planner and Microsoft To Do in one list, dragged into the Outlook calendar as focus blocks

g.text: Planner and To Do are optional,

svg.text: Drag a task into a free slot and it becomes a focus block in Outlook. Whether a task is planned is read live from the calendar.
